meta.name: customer-onboarding-and-implementation
meta.description: Takes a new customer from signature to working — setting a definition of live that both sides agreed before the contract was signed, planning and staffing the implementation, running data migration and integration realistically, training the people who will actually use it, and handing over to the ongoing relationship. Use this to design an onboarding motion, rescue a stalled implementation, work out why customers who bought never went live, or scope the services a deal actually needs.

copy.tagline: 帮新客户从签约走到正式启用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责让签约客户真正用起来
copy.tagline_en: Help new customers go from signed contract to actual go-live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're in charge of getting signed customers to genuinely use the product

howto.what: 把新客户从签约带到真正可用：先约定双方认可的“上线”标准，再按项目推进实施、评估数据迁移与集成、给实际使用者做任务培训，最后交接给长期关系维护。
howto.when: 当你想设计客户上线流程、挽救停滞的实施、找出客户买了却未启用的原因，或评估某个合同到底需要哪些服务时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个客户写一份上线成功标准，包括哪些团队、做什么、需要什么数据。
say.note: 会产出可签进合同的 go-live 标准。

say.text: 我们有个客户实施卡住了，客户那边说没人能拍板，怎么推进？
say.note: 会给出找客户负责人、重设节奏的步骤。

say.text: 距离上线还有两个月，请规划分阶段培训，先教会一个团队做日常任务。
say.note: 会生成贴近上线时间的在职任务培训计划。
